PR165 @cursor[bot] apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/components/EmbeddedTerminal.tsx:204
### Terminal remount duplicates live output

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
`onData` starts buffering into `pendingLive` before `snapshot()` runs, and the main process appends those same bytes to the ring that `snapshot()` returns. Writing the snapshot and then flushing `pendingLive` therefore replays the overlap, so first attach and worktree remounts can show a doubled prompt or repeated log lines.
<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->

PR163 @cursor[bot] packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts:545
### Startup reclaim skipped on typical launches

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
Orphan run reclaim is tied to `reclaimStaleTurns`, but the desktop app only passes that when cwd is a git repo. Packaged Dock launches skip that block, so after a crash or force-quit the UI can still show stale `activeRuns` and leftover listeners are not cleared until the user hits Stop.
<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->

PR163 @cursor[bot] packages/core/src/hook/conductor.ts:274
### Port kill blocks the main thread

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
`killListenersOnPorts` now uses `execFileSync` with a login `zsh` (or PowerShell) once per persisted port. Each run records a 10-port range, and Stop/quit invoke this on the Electron main thread, so the UI and `will-quit` can stall for seconds while shells source rc files.

PR161 @cursor[bot] apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/components/EmbeddedTerminal.tsx:201
### Replay drops output after async write

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
Chunked `writeXtermScrollback` stretches the window where `attached` is false, but catch-up is still a single follow-up `snapshot` that only applies when `second.startsWith(first)`. Live `onData` is dropped during those rAF yields. Once the 256 KB cap slides, the prefix check fails and the delta is skipped, so remount can show a gap until the next replay.
<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->

PR156 @cursor[bot] apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/lib/script-output-paint.ts:105
### Script clear drops sibling logs

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
`createKeyedScriptOutputPainter.clear(key)` cancels the shared animation frame and does not reschedule a flush for other scripts. Pending lines for concurrent runs stay in the map with `raf` cleared, so they are never painted until some later `push`. Starting one script while another is logging can stall or drop that other script’s output.
<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->

### Setup hydrate skipped until opened

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
`getSetupLog` now lives only inside `SetupOutputStream`, which mounts when `setupOpened` is true. The sidebar no longer hydrates on worktree bind, so a worktree whose setup is already running does not restore `setupRunning` or switch to Setup unless that tab was already selected. Returning to a worktree last left on Run/Terminal hides an in-flight setup until the user opens Setup.
